articles.title_en: World has six consecutive days 2C above preindustrial levels for first time
articles.title_vi: [EN-Source] World has six consecutive days 2C above preindustrial levels for first time
articles.summary_en: Daily global surface temperature hit record 2.24C above baseline levels on Monday and streak is forecast to continue For the first time, the world has experienced six consecutive days of temperatures 2C warmer than preindustrial levels, the Guardian has learned. This record hot streak , which is continuing, is too brief to signify that the upper range of the Paris climate agreement target has been breached, but scientists said it was an early indication of what is to come unless fossil fuel emissions are rapidly eliminated. It is also likely to feed into growing scientific concerns that global heating may be accelerating .

articles.title_en: ‘Symbolic’: Why did UK sanction Yemen’s Houthis amid attacks on Saudi?
articles.title_vi: [EN-Source] ‘Symbolic’: Why did UK sanction Yemen’s Houthis amid attacks on Saudi?
articles.summary_en: UK sanctions Iran-backed group and its leaders, accusing them of undermining stability in the Middle East. London, United Kingdom – The United Kingdom has slapped sanctions on Yemen’s Houthis and four of their senior leaders after accusing the Iran-backed group of renewed “aggression” inside Yemen and attacks targeting civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. The Houthis have escalated attacks on Saudi Arabia, targeting the financial district in Riyadh this week, as they engage in a civil war with Yemen’s internationally recognised government.
